question: Should `/v1/chat/completions` expose internal OpenClaw tool-call telemetry, and if so should that be a redacted opt-in diagnostic mode or live in a Responses/trace surface instead?
rationale: Current docs and source define this endpoint as a client-tool contract, while internal tool telemetry can reveal sensitive operator context and changes the OpenAI-compatible API shape.

options.title: Keep Chat Completions client-tool-only
options.body: Route internal tool visibility to an explicit redacted Responses, trace, or diagnostic design instead of changing the Chat Completions compatibility contract.

options.title: Add an opt-in Chat Completions extension
options.body: Design a default-off flag or request mode with redaction, scopes, docs, and tests before exposing internal tool names or arguments.

options.title: Decline internal telemetry
options.body: Document that internal tool activity remains available only through existing Gateway events, logs, or diagnostics and not through OpenAI-compatible responses.

recommendation.title: Keep Chat Completions client-tool-only
recommendation.body: Route internal tool visibility to an explicit redacted Responses, trace, or diagnostic design instead of changing the Chat Completions compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows this account landed and followed up on the Chat Completions tool contract and is the best routed owner for the product/security boundary choice.
